description: Creates a battle in setup, as New battle on the site does, and returns its token. opponentId seats one opponent from list_my_opponents for a duel; opponentIds seats one or two, and allyId seats a friend on your side, for a 2v1 or doubles; guestNames seats one or two opponents without an account by name. limit is the battle size in points (1000, 2000, 3000, or 600 for King of the Colosseum); omit it to take the size from the rosters. missionPackId is a mission pack id from list_reference. casual: true plays it outside a tournament both players are entered in. manual: true tracks by hand without mission cards, stratagems or CP automation. groupToken counts it for a group both players are in, and fixture names that group's league fixture. Then set it up with submit_battle_action, following get_my_battle's next. Requires mcp:write.
name: create_battle
title: Create a battle
